integrity: Standalone finite enumeration and orbit verifier bundled; general upper and lower bounds are mathematical arguments. No independent mathematical audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact shattered-support polynomial and orbits are proved by exhaustive computation only for five atoms. For six or more atoms only the two explicit exponential-order bounds are established; no exact general dimension formula is asserted. Historical priority under alternate terminology is not globally certified. Full text of Ignatov 2023 was not accessible, so abstract-level comparison alone is incomplete.
title: Shattering maximal Sperner families: an exponential lower bound and the exact five-atom profile
